borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Submission of details of external facing materials (including manufacturer's specifications, photographs and/ or a physical sample), pursuant to Condition 3; details of a Ventilation Strategy Report to mitigate the impact of existing poor air quality for the self-contained dwellinghouse (Use Class C3), pursuant to Condition 8; details of a preliminary risk assessment report, pursuant to Condition 12; details of a site investigation scheme, pursuant to Condition 13; details of a quantitative risk assessment report, pursuant to Condition 14; details of a remediation method statement, pursuant to Condition 15; details of a verification report confirming that the approved remediation method statement has been carried out in full, pursuant to Condition 16; details of an onward long-term monitoring methodology report, pursuant to Condition 17; details of a Construction Management Plan, pursuant to Condition 18; details of an enhanced sound insulation value DnT,w + Ctr  and L'nT,w of at least 10dB above the Building Regulations value, for the floor/ceiling /wall structures separating different types of rooms/ uses in adjoining dwellings, pursuant to Condition 19; details of a Construction Logistics Plan, pursuant to Condition 20; and details of an updated Drainage Strategy, pursuant to Condition 21 of planning permission reference: 2024/01917/FUL dated 2nd May 2025.
